systems.owner: the State (MATD and the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection are the ministries addressed); Multimédia Glory Guinée (MGG) SARL is the technical partner deploying the system and supplying the enrolment equipment

note: The document describes the system as the enrolment of citizens' data at enrolment centres for the issue of biometric documents, announced as free; it does not describe the registration of births or deaths, so no civil fact. The contractor MGG alleged illegal fees at some centres on 28 July 2026.
